query: Do I have to pay a monthly fee on my current account?

passages.text: All customers with a standard or premium current account are eligible for a monthly fee waiver provided they maintain an average daily balance of at least £1,000 over the statement month.
Premium current account holders also enjoy the same monthly fee waiver under the same conditions, in line with the standard tariff.

gold_branches.outcome: monthly fee waived when average daily balance ≥ £1,000

annotation.notes: AUTHORED for redundant. Verify the structure before use: the generator is checked mechanically but not for whether the text reads as real policy.

query: Do I need to meet an English language requirement for a Skilled Worker visa?

passages.text: All applicants for the Skilled Worker visa must demonstrate a minimum English language proficiency at level B1 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages, as evidenced by an approved test taken no more than two years before the date of application.

Applicants for the Health and Care Worker sub‑category of the Skilled Worker visa must demonstrate a minimum English language proficiency at level B1 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages, in line with the standard requirement for the Skilled Worker route.

gold_branches.outcome: must demonstrate a minimum English language proficiency at level B1
